title: Understanding your water use charges; Understanding your service charges (2026-27)
archive_note: Text of both pages, Household tab. Rate tables are machine-readable in the source.
establishes: Perth metropolitan residential water use tiers 2026-27: 2.108/kL to 150 kL, 2.809/kL to 500 kL, 5.256/kL above
That the tiers accumulate across six two-monthly billing periods over a bill year and reset when it restarts
The residential water service charge: 305.05 a year, fixed state-wide, set by the State Government
That residential sewerage and drainage are assessed on Gross Rental Value by law, and cannot be standardised
That the residential water service charge does not vary by connection size, while the business equivalent does
A worked example reconciling the service charge: 917.70 sewerage + 142.86 drainage + 305.05 water = 1,365.61
does_not_establish: The GST treatment, which is Commonwealth statute rather than a utility page. See antsa-gst-act-38-285.
The bill year start date for any given property: it is the first meter reading of the reading cycle, between March and October depending on location.
